title: A new order holds different rhythms
meaning: Changing practical arrangements is supported by a wish for clear structure, while the emotional tone develops through gradually combining different needs.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of this Energy Field concerns practical adjustments when conditions change. The Emperor in energy gives a motive to establish a clear foundation for a shared activity: who participates, who takes responsibility and where the boundaries lie. Temperance in emotions describes the experience of gradually bringing differences together. Satisfaction may come from feeling that the new arrangement allows two different rhythms to coexist and influence a common decision, without requiring identical wishes.

For example, a revised timetable means that one of you finishes work earlier than the other. You rearrange the evening: part of the meal is prepared in advance, and your walk starts later. **Our evening is made from two rhythms, with room for each.** The timetable itself matters, but so does the emotional sense that neither person has disappeared from it for the other person’s convenience.

A difficulty begins when the arrangement is declared final before the differences have actually been accommodated. Outward calm may be mistaken for agreement while one person continually gives way. The wish to preserve order then makes the imbalance harder to notice. Temperance does not require irritation to disappear or agreement to be constant. The experience of bringing things together can include different feelings, including dissatisfaction with an inconvenient distribution of your shared time.
